name: architecture-jira-tasker
description: Architecture-to-Jira assistant for turning completed architecture docs into human-readable, QA-checkable Jira delivery tasks without leaking development details.

interface.shortDescription: Creates human-readable, QA-checkable Jira tasks from architecture docs.
interface.longDescription: Architecture Jira Tasker converts completed architecture documentation into large, self-contained Jira delivery tasks for human planning, review, release, and QA. It applies project-specific Jira format profiles, plans a coherent one-week delivery scope, fills rich Jira metadata, writes a compact 30-second Russian summary and issue description with developer/manual tester acceptance criteria and explicit verification evidence, limits labels to specific delivery-area signals, and creates the task on the actual Jira board when a Jira connector is available and the user approves the final proposal. Implementation details, confidential data, and hidden requirements stay out of the Jira task body.
defaultPrompt: Use $architecture-jira-tasker:architecture-jira-tasker to create a Jira task from these completed architecture docs.
Use $architecture-jira-tasker:task-scope-planner to shape this architecture handoff into one large human-visible delivery task.
Use $architecture-jira-tasker:task-review-gate to check whether this Jira task is self-contained before creation.
